name: Kitsune medium kick
notes: Head-high straight kick (foot at 107 cm = 214 units, hitbox y 150-210), clip 24 frames (1.2x), hit 8-10: 7/3/14 = C8, no deviation. Blend-out: leg back to 40% at the cut, blend the last 4-6 ticks. Standing mid (not low). Hakama tube not added to the hurtbox beyond the leg box. Body hurtbox E5 for the whole move. Hitstun, blockstun and pushback are placeholders (not in rules.md); damage is the C8 number.
